steps.name: 'Mother'
steps.text: Qui'saršinnag...

steps.name: 'Mother'
steps.text: Qui'saršinnag.

steps.name: 'Mother'
steps.text: Mama's here. It's alright, I just need to talk to your father for a bit.

steps.name: 'Mother'
steps.text: Didn't you want to look around outside?

steps.name: 'Mother'
steps.text: Just like the blue fowlbeast in your favorite story... the fowlbeast that can fly high up into the soft, lofty clouds.

steps.name: 'Mother'
steps.text: You can do it. You should live a free life.

steps.name: 'Mother'
steps.text: I'm sorry, my dear child...

steps.name: 'Mother'
steps.text: ...Mama will get you away from all of this.

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: Qui'saršinnag.

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: Enough hiding. I know you're there.

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: You followed her in secret when she came to find me. You witnessed... everything. That's good.

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: You need not be afraid of the blood. You'll see much more in the future.

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: Will I die?

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: Of course, my dear. Look, this sword has pierced through my heart. It won't take long before the blood in this body dries up.

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: Your mother... wants to leave me because of some pointless delusions, and have you leave me as well...

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: But how is that possible? We have long been bound together by the myriad souls, we cannot be separated.

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: Go, child. Touch your mother... can you feel it? Her pulse.

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: This is the power of life, our cycle of life. Through rebirths like this, again and again, will our lives be perfected.

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: I will always be with you.

steps.name: 'Father'
steps.text: We... shall never part.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: My dear Qui'saršinnag, you don't seem happy at all.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Didn't the experiment go smoothly? The receptacle has been responding perfectly from the last few tests.

steps.name: 'Daughter'
steps.text: When the ceremony is complete, what will happen to her?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Her? You mean the... receptacle?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: When it was born, its soul was no longer with us.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: After all, the Leader has been researching for so long just to craft a cage from a pure consciousness, to trick the King of Sarkaz.

spans.text: After all, the Leader has been researching for so long just to craft a cage from a pure consciousness, to trick the

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: When that happens, the King's power will be transferred to you, and the receptacle will be useless.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: You can decorate it like a doll if you like, and bring her wherever you go. I do like to collect souvenirs too.

steps.name: 'Daughter'
steps.text: It is none of your concern.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Hah, you're always so impolite with me. Want it out of your sight? Just dispose of it. Or... you could give it to me?

steps.name: 'Daughter'
steps.text: Leave. Do not step into my laboratory without my permission ever again.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Why are you so... offended? The Leader and you have such different temperaments... well, it's fine. You'll soon become as gentle as he is.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Who knows, I might even miss your current personality...

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Goodbye, Qui'saršinnag.

a.text: She looks through her mask at the girl on the stone bed, who returns her gaze.
There is still work to do, and her father will not allow any delays.

This altar, this laboratory... and the bloodline she was born into together form a cage around her. In the face of the Confessarii's calling for the past several millennia, her sorrow and suffering are insignificant.
She does not control her own limbs, they are extensions of her father's will.
She cannot stop or leave this altar fiddling with life and death, nor can she drop the soul-engraving white sword in her hand.
Suddenly, a drop of water falls onto her busy hand.
Who is the one shedding tears here...? Her, or the figure on the bed, who should be completely unconscious?
'Qui'saršinnag.'
Distracted, she lifts her head, and sees a blue fowlbeast fly out of the cave and into the dusk outside.

steps.text: Cracks appear on the cage.
A consciousness that should not exist, yearning for freedom it could not possibly have.
From this, hope is born.
A Confessarius and a pure white receptacle.
Qui'saršinnag and Liz.
Shining... and Nightingale.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I'm hearing a din of discontent.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Do not worry, Leader! Only a few enemies have broken into this place.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: They want to destroy the altar and stop the ceremony.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Annoying pests. Send someone to clean them up.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Surely I need not sully my hands with such trifles?

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: Of course not—

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: We shall eradicate all obstacles in your stead.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Hm...
The Confessarius Leader looks at the girl dressed in white. She's so deep in sleep on the stone bed that she almost looks like she is not breathing.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: The 'Receptacle's' Originium Arts are stable, the ceremony will soon be complete.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: We're only a step away before Amnannam will open a path for you to the myriad souls.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: You will surpass the King of Sarkaz, supersede the myriad souls, and become the father of all Sarkaz.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: With our journey spanning thousands of years... this is how things should be.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Before that, I will have to reunite with my kin to witness it together.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Right on time, sister.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I have been waiting for you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: More Confessarius guards incoming...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maryla, let's part ways here. I can't guarantee I'll be able to keep you and your companions safe in our next fight.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The roads should be safer once you leave this place. If you're willing to do so, you can continue heading east all the way out of Victoria.

steps.name: 'Shopkeep'
steps.text: Your Highness... I'll never forget your kindness, no matter where I end up!

steps.name: 'Driver'
steps.text: But what are you guys planning to do?

steps.name: 'Miner'
steps.text: This blade of mine is still usable, if you need it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry, we have our own mission, and we're set on it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please... take care of yourselves, and then... um, I hope you can live the life you want to live.

steps.name: 'Driver'
steps.text: Your Highness...
Maryla takes a step forward and kneels on one knee before Amiya. The other two follow suit, all three faces bearing a rare solemn look.

steps.name: 'Driver'
steps.text: You've gained the undying loyalty of a... no, three Sarkaz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh? Please... you don't have to do this...
The mercenaries hesitate for a bit before turning to leave, fading from your view.

options: I hope Logos is doing well...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We have little time left, and the Confessarius altar is close.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Logos helped us dispel the Confessarius illusions, and I can feel an unsettling energy disturbance here...

options: So are we going in loud?
Any secret passage to the altar or something similar?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Time isn't going to let us slowly figure a surefire solution.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We can't overlook the risks, but it's also important to take rational risks in our war strategies.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Fortunately, the Sarkaz have done as much, and sent all their troops to the front lines. So we need only deal with the Confessarius's men.

options: Theresis must trust Qui'sartuštaj a lot.
Why are the Confessarii in charge of the Amnannam advent ceremony?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Confessarii play many roles in Kazdel. They are the King's advisers, bodyguards, shamans, and scholars.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They travel between the Royal Courts, and have always been dedicated to exploring Sarkaz history, and researching the power of their blood.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresis already planned to use the Shard to control Amnannam before invading Londinium, and the Confessarii definitely helped him out.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Qui'sartuštaj's plan to usurp the King is also closely tied to Amnannam.

options: What does Amnannam have to do with the King?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Qui'sartuštaj wants more than just the crown.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He too, once possessed the King's power thousands of years ago.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He did not manage to get the full picture, but he definitely sensed the King's power to influence others.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Control'. The more you experience absolute power, the harder it is to resist temptation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Be it Theresa or Amiya, Qui'sartuštaj has been watching every single King and their successors in secret for a long, long time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: His obsession with power compels him to extend his life by maniacal means without hesitation, just to seize control of that power once more.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There is only one thing that can let him achieve his goal.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Through Originium, Qui'sartuštaj will be able to control the Sarkaz more than the King ever could.

options: Shining and Nightingale... are also victims of his.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They never stopped resisting their fate... especially at such a critical moment as now.

options: We have to stop Amnannam and its uncontrollable effects—
We have to stop the Confessarii from harming Rhodes Island's Operators—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr, hold off our enemies.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, destroy the altar.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, I'm sensing something's up...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't quite control... the King's power...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That altar's influencing—

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I've told you before. We've been researching the Crown for thousands of years. But you? How long has it been since you learned how to use it?

steps.name: Salus
steps.text: I welcome you all to bear witness to this grand ceremony.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...Qui'sartuštaj.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Everyone here is waiting for you.
The Confessarius Leader smiles as usual, spreading his arms wide open as if welcoming his own child back after a long time away from home.
Dozens of Confessarii stand on both sides of the mountain path in silence.
Their eyes behind their masks hold fervent deference, completely ignoring the blood drenched Shining as she walks up the steps with her sword in hand.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I'm here to kill you.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: How could I... not know that?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Many years ago, mother showed up before father, before me, just like you have now.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: She always knew her own duty, and never thought to disobey me.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: But as you slowly grew, she developed a hatred to our family, the love I gave her... and the Confessarius's calling.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I don't blame her at all, nor do I blame you. You are the same. Merely made a tiny, forgivable mistake.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I will always accept you returning to my side.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You are a monster. Who are you to speak of love?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Love and hate, life and death. They are fundamentally part of the same whole.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Generations of Confessarii have passed their souls down through the same rites. This is my way of loving my family.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Souls in death are purified in rebirth. Through death after death... we close in on the original, the purest and perfect being.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: There is not a shred of that worthy to be... perfect.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Qui'sartuštaj. Your true self died thousands of years ago.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: The white horned King of Sarkaz who defeated countless enemies, the legendary hero who built an everlasting Kazdel under the day and night—is long dead.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: What stands before me now is but a despicable man who lives in the shadows, a coward who sacrifices the lives of innumerable innocents to prolong his own.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Who is it that tarnishes the soul of that original hero?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It's you, King of Usurping Kings—You got so twisted seeking longevity. You are no longer worthy of that crown.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: ...Perhaps.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Qui'saršinnag... Sister.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I, who was born with all my memories intact... know better than you, the history Qui'sartuštaj bears with his life.
The Confessarius Leader takes a step down.
He calmly looks at Shining, and holds her hand trembling in rage.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I know all too well the blood that is on my hands, as I remember all the love I have received.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: It was you who picked me up from the blood into your trembling arms when mother died.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: We are a true family, sharing the closest of blood, and sharing the closest of relationships.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: The nature of my soul may change, but the facts remain the same.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: How could you... talk about that like so...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Who was it...that killed my brother?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Who was it, that turned him from a child who should have received his mother's love... into a non-existence from the very beginning?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: It was me.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: For millennia, Qui'sartuštaj has... died time and time again from betrayal, from his closest kin.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: You may see this as a punishment if you wish it so.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: However... what does that matter?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: You call me unworthy of that crown, but who else but me could possibly lead the Sarkaz on a path to our survival?!

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Qui'lon brought our people on a wandering path of no return, and Yliš's retreat into hiding would only make us weak.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Even that pair of siblings, all they did was push Sarkaz into futile conflict, and let the crown slip into outblood hands!

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: The Sarkaz... need a true King, an eternal King.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I will reach our starting point, and together with the sins of Qui'sartuštaj and his blood, purge all of the Sarkaz's sins!

a.text: Sin.
The word intensifies the ire in Shining.
Her father and brother were both possessed by this undying monster—while she and her mother lived under the madness of his shadow.
To let him live, to kill him—both are afflicted with the curse.
She has no path to go.
She has nowhere to retreat.
But there is no way she can stay here as is.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: ...Ugh!

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: You... made your move.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Very good... Qui'saršinnag...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...I'll kill you.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: And then...

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Kill yourself?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Is this what you call severing the bloodline's curse?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: The same stupidity I see.
Qui'sartuštaj grips Shining's sword with hand.
Blood trickles down the pure white blade and stains her hand.
A shudder rises from the depths of her soul.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: —Ugh!
An overwhelming force flings Shining onto a crystal tree.
The sharp black branches pierce through her abdomen.
Fresh blood gushes down, and converges with Qui'sartuštaj's blood.
The ancient tree long crystallized into Originium bursts a sudden pure white glow.
In just a moment, countless little moons rise to the top of the tree.
Every Confessarius begins to sing—

a.text: The myriad souls lie prostrate.
Howling knocks on the door from beneath, tangible usurps the intangible.
The Black Crown imprisoned, the offender perpetually innocent.
Because kings are born before immortality.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Look, even injuries as grievous as this will not infect you—this is the power of the blood you resist.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Qui'saršinnag... I have been patient enough with you.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: But you stay stubborn, unwilling to accept all that belongs to you—your duty, power, glory.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: It's alright, just be good and stay aside, while I... complete the ceremony myself.
A crown woven of thorns appears in his hand.
Moonlight shines onto the crown as it illuminates the crystal tree at the end of the steps.
In that spot lies a stone bed lined with dead branches, and a curled up figure Shining knows too well atop it.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Liz...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...Wake up.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Don't bother.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Her consciousness is not where you think it to be.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: She's inside the crown.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I promised you that I would mend her soul.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: You need only wear the complete crown, and you can be together forever.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Together forever... in your cage?
Shining shuts her eyes.
She strains to imagine... the time she spent together with Liz.
They run in the woods, hand in hand.
They cross the ice-cold creek together.
With Liz worn out on her back, she walks the road home.
Liz makes a small flower wreath and places it on Shining's head.
A small blue fowlbeast follows them the whole time, chirping a cheery tune over their heads.
It hovers, searches—and lands next to the sleeping white demon.
It does not know why Liz is sleeping, and anxiously pecks at her cheek with its little beak.
Until a black arrow pierces it.
The fowlbeast vanishes, leaving only a blue feather that lands on Shining's shoulder.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Enough.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: You know very well those are not her dreams.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Even if those memories were fabricated...

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: They are fabricated, so why not accept your own power, and reshape her memory once more?

spans.text: fabricated, so why not accept your own power, and reshape her memory once more?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Liz... is Liz.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: She should be free. I will never shape her soul as I please ever again.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: Wishful thinking... Qui'saršinnag, my fragile child indulging in fantasy. You are that blue fowlbeast, thirsting for freedom, yet imprisoning yourself.

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: I prepared everything for you, a perfect body, an ancient power, all you needed is to accept—

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: But you betrayed me, you abandoned everything that belongs to you, and then? What did you gain?

steps.name: Qui'sartuštaj
steps.text: You sorely disappoint me.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...A new life.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I was reborn into a new life after leaving you.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Not as the Confessarius Qui'saršinnag, nor a puppet of my bloodline...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: But as Shining...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...As a member of the Followers.
Blue feathers prick her wounds.
The slightest of stings momentarily rouses her from her bloodline-induced paralysis.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Come.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Now... is the time.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Find me. Find this tree.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: If it were you...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...You would certainly make it.
An opening pierces through the crimson clouds.
The sunlight pours down—
Everything around her becomes increasingly brighter.

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: That's—

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: It doesn't matter what it is, just hold it back!

steps.name: Confessarius Guard
steps.text: The ceremony has already begun, we can't let—Ugh! We can't stop it!
Light.
Light and fog fills the air.
The sun descends from the sky to repel the clammy moonlight.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Sorry, the storm was too intense, so I took some time to locate you—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Do you need a hand... Shining?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...I'm fine.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: But we have to save... Liz.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: And... stop Qui'sartuštaj.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Lend me your strength—

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: And dispel the darkness before my eyes.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Let's go together.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The road ahead of us... I'll illuminate our path.
